notes: NEW: View Civ. Show off a civ on one page, laid out like an in-game card: bonuses, unique unit with its stats, unique techs, team bonus, hero and tech tree. Copy it as Markdown or text, save it as PNG, WebP or PDF, or print it. Retype the text on the card before sharing, and save the civ with the new description. Thanks to darius_the_russian_cat

NEW: Custom bonuses for unit lines. Target a whole line ("Militia line: +2 attack") or a unit and everything it upgrades into ("Long Swordsman and up: +20 HP"). Lines are grouped by building on the Units tab. Thanks to rattatatouille

NEW: A Civilization tab for custom bonuses: raise the population limit from a chosen age, or give one-time resources at the start or on reaching an age ("+100 stone at the start", "+200 wood on reaching the Castle Age"). Thanks to vindy
NEW: Population space on buildings ("Barracks: +10 population space"). Thanks to vindy

NEW: Minimum range, blast radius and conversion as custom bonus effects: Mangonels that fire closer, Scorpions with no minimum range, wider siege splash, faster Monk conversions and harder-to-convert units. Thanks to varamir
NEW: Farms and Monasteries as custom bonus targets: one card for every farm type (Farms, Fish Traps, Rice Farms, Pastures), or for Monasteries and Fortified Churches
NEW: A custom Elite upgrade cost and research time for your unique unit. Thanks to iquit

BUG FIX: Your civ's name not showing. A unique unit description written over several lines broke the mod's text file, so the game showed the replaced civ's name everywhere. Line breaks and quotes in any of your civ's text are now handled. Thanks to Patient

BUG FIX: Renaming a game unique unit renames it for your civ only. A renamed unit (say, the Ghulam) used to be renamed for the civ it came from as well, and its Elite upgrade kept the old name. Thanks to Patient

NEW: Chronicles unique units. The Immortal, Strategos, Hippeus, Companion Cavalry, Rhomphaia Warrior and Pattiyodha Longbowman can now be your civ's unique unit, trained at the Castle. Find them under Chronicles in the Unique Unit step. Their unlock cards are retired; civs that already have one keep it
BUG FIX: The Donjon gets tower unique techs. Unique techs that boost towers (Yasama, Eupseong, Great Wall, Stronghold, Detinets) now boost the Donjon too
CHANGED: The Sannāhya has the Battle Elephant's HP: 250, Elite 300
BUG FIX: Custom unique tech research times never reached the game. Every custom UT researched in the game's default time. Fixed

BUG FIX: Elephant bonuses reach every elephant. "+1/+1 armor", "+10% speed", the elephant discount, bonus-damage resistance and Howdah only reached Battle Elephants. They now reach War Elephants, Elephant Archers, Armored Elephants and the Sannāhya too (Elephant Archers don't get the speed bonus). Thanks to rattatatouille

BUG FIX: Monks speak with a voice that matches their look. A female Monk skin (South American, Norse) with a male Monk voice, or the other way round, now uses the same language's villager lines of the matching voice. Thanks to rattatatouille
BUG FIX: The Imperial Skirmisher team bonus gives allies the upgrade again. Thanks to rattatatouille
BUG FIX: "Spearmen and Skirmishers train at Settlements" no longer moves the Barracks Spearman to a second page. Thanks to rattatatouille

BUG FIX: A replaced civ no longer shows through. The civ selection list and the in-game tech tree (F2) showed the original civ's unique techs and unique unit line, and could show another civ's unique unit. Thanks to maruviel
BUG FIX: Charge Attack on a unique unit now uses the game's own charge (the Comitatenses'), and works for ranged units too

BUG FIX: Heroes picked in the Builder train from Castle button 4 again, so the Trebuchet keeps its own; a tech tree that unticks a tech the Galleon or Gillnets needs no longer leaves them unresearchable
BUG FIX: The custom bonus maker only offers effects a target can use, so no more garrison space on Villagers or range on a Champion
BUG FIX: The Mapuche team bonus card says +2 line of sight, as the game does, not attack range. Thanks to darius_the_russian_cat
CHANGED: "Siege Towers can fire arrows" is withdrawn. A Siege Tower has no ranged attack, so the bonus never did anything. Civs that had it still load, without it. Thanks to Agent Forest
CHANGED: The Windows app reads unit voices from your own game files instead of carrying a copy, so the download is about 30 MB smaller

BUG FIX: Civ bonuses not showing in the Windows app. 2.5.0 added a unit name with an accented letter (Sannāhya), and the Windows app read the bonus list in the wrong text encoding, so the whole bonus screen came up empty. Fixed — and names with accents no longer show garbled characters on Windows

NEW: Chronicles bonuses. Bonuses from the Chronicles civilizations that work with ordinary units and techs, marked with a helmet: cavalry also receive the infantry armor upgrades (Macedonians), siege +1 pierce armor and +30% vs. buildings, Stable technologies research 50% faster, skirmishers regenerate HP, and stone miners slowly generate food. Team bonuses: Outposts can be upgraded into arrow-firing Fortified Outposts, Barracks technologies research 50% faster, buildings +3 line of sight, Trade Carts +15% speed. Thanks to Min-maxer96 and Dreams Alike for the Fortified Outpost idea

NEW: Chronicles units under a new purple Chronicles banner: Immortal, Strategos, Hippeus, Companion Cavalry, Phalangite, Rhomphaia Warrior, Pattiyodha Longbowman, Sannāhya and Hoplite, each with its elite upgrade — plus the Scythian Horse Archer, which replaces the Cavalry Archer line
NEW: Palintonon: your Trebuchet takes on the Chronicles Palintonon's look and name, and hits 15% harder. Every Trebuchet upgrade still applies
FASTER: Builds are much faster. After the first build, the game file loads in about a second instead of twenty, and a typical mod builds in seconds
BUG FIX: Picking a hero no longer takes away your Trebuchet. Heroes now train from Castle button 4, so the Trebuchet keeps its own

BUG FIX: Unique units and heroes get the game's full tooltip — cost with icons, description, upgrades and stats — instead of a plain line of text. An unchanged unique unit (like the Mangudai) no longer loses its tooltip, for you or for the civ it comes from

BUG FIX: Units the game enables the way it enables the Hearth Troop now show up correctly in the tech tree and button layout, and build warnings no longer name renamed units with stray campaign dialogue

NEW: Custom bonuses. Build your own bonus cards: pick a target — a group like Cavalry, a single unit, a villager job or a building — and stack as many effects as you like ("Cavalry: +20% HP, +2 pierce armor"). Cards are saved to your own library, can be shared as a file, and are picked into any civ like the built-in ones

NEW: A Tech tab for custom bonuses: target an age, every tech at a building, an upgrade set (farm, mining, the Blacksmith lines and more), your unique techs or any single tech — and make it cheaper, faster, instant or free
NEW: Your unique techs now show their descriptions on the civ selection screen, the way the game's own civs do

BUG FIX: Your unique techs now appear in the in-game tech tree. Since the latest game update, the tree showed the replaced civ's unique techs, crossed out, and never yours. Thanks to darius_the_russian_cat
BUG FIX: "Stable units +1P armor in Castle and Imperial Age" gave melee armor instead of pierce. Fixed — and every armor card is now checked against what it says. Thanks to Ping

BUG FIX: The Lithuanian relic bonus now powers up your unique unit. It used to boost the Leitis — which your civ doesn't have — so your unique unit got nothing. Ranged unique units like the Mangudai get the bonus as pierce attack, so it actually counts. Thanks to trefoilknot

BUG FIX: Multipliers on attack and armor bonuses. Raising the multiplier on an attack bonus ("Cavalry +1 attack" at ×2 or more) quietly applied it against the wrong armor type, so the unit's attack never went up. Very high multipliers on attack bonuses could stop the mod from building at all. Both fixed. Thanks to iquit

BUG FIX: Stacked unique techs no longer crash the game. A custom unique tech with several effects at high multipliers could grow past the game's limit and crash it before the main menu. Oversized unique techs are now split behind the scenes, and all of their effects still apply

BUG FIX: Working on several civs in different browser tabs. Tabs used to overwrite each other's work. Each tab now keeps its own civ, and the last one you edited still comes back when you reopen the builder. Thanks to trefoilknot

BUG FIX: Mods with several civs: a third civ with the Winged Hussar, Heavy Cavalry Archer or "eco upgrades one age earlier" bonus no longer loses it, imported Krakenmeister civs keep the Galleon and Fishing Lines, and units granted by bonuses (Missionary, Mounted Trebuchet, War Chariot) no longer land on a button the civ already uses
BUG FIX: The Folwark works again, the Huns house bonus hides the House, the free relic bonus is fixed, quotes in your civ's text no longer break its strings, and any emblem image format is accepted
CHANGED: The multiplier is hidden on seven unique techs where it never changed anything — Gothikon, Curare, Atheism, Cuman Mercenaries, Bimaristan, Coiled Serpent Array and Ordo Cavalry

BUG FIX: Fixed the "both pages of the Castle are full" warnings. Building a civ from a full tech tree warned that nearly every unique unit in the game couldn't be trained at the Castle. Those units were never yours — only your own unique unit is trained there — and the warnings are gone
BUG FIX: Units your civ doesn't have no longer get moved to a second page, and the Button Layout card no longer shows clashes with them

NEW: Every civ's voice. Thirteen civs had no voice to choose — Armenians, Georgians, Shu, Wu, Wei, Jurchens, Khitans, Muisca, Mapuche, Tupi, Saxons, Varangians and Danes. All of them are now in the Voice picker, taken straight from the game's own audio

NEW: Units no longer fight over a training button. Pick Eagle Warriors and Fire Lancers and Varangian Guard — the building gets a second page, just like the game's "all techs" mode. Every unit that moves takes its upgrades along, one row below it, with hotkeys that match the first page
NEW: Button Layout on the Save step. When units share a button, choose which one stays on the first page, and see both pages of each building laid out before you build
CHANGED: The tech tree no longer makes you choose between units that share a building slot. Take as many as you like; the extras go to page two
BUG FIX: Voices in the Windows app. Mods built with the downloadable app left out the voice files, so a custom civ spoke with the voice of the civ it replaced. They are now included
BUG FIX: Saxon, Varangian, Dane, Muisca, Mapuche, Tupi and Khitan villagers said the same line whether building, chopping, mining or hunting. Each task now has its own line
BUG FIX: A handful of voice lines played the replaced civ's voice instead of yours — most noticeably every Inca soldier line, plus some Mayan, Tatar, Slav, Persian and Aztec lines. Fixed
BUG FIX: The Byzantine voice now uses the game's current, re-recorded lines
BUG FIX: Ticking Cranequins in the tech tree no longer drags in Parthian Tactics and the Heavy Mounted Crossbowman. It needs only the Mounted Crossbowman

BUG FIX: Fixed the builder hanging on "Loading" at startup. 2.2.0 made the wizard wait for your game files to be read before it would draw anything, which took around half a minute on a cold start and looked like a freeze. The file is now read in the background, as it was before
If you downloaded 2.2.0, please update — that build cannot get past the first screen.
NEW: Viking Sagas support. Saxons, Varangians and Danes can be replaced like any other civ, with their wonders, castles, and the new Nordic architecture and Monk

NEW: Mounted Crossbowman and Varangian Guard in the tech tree. Each shares a building slot with the units it replaces — Mounted Crossbowman with the Cavalry Archer and Elephant Archer, Varangian Guard with the Fire Lancer and Eagle line — so picking one removes the others, the same way the tree has always handled regional units. Cranequins comes and goes with the Mounted Crossbowman
NEW: Three unique units — Hearth Troop, Jarl and Jomsviking — and seven unique techs: Ordonnance Companies, Clerical Recruitment, Vendel Legacy, Hamask, Shield Wall, Gothikon and Northmen's Fury
NEW: 12 new civ bonus cards and 3 new team bonuses, taken from the three new civs
NEW: The six South American unique units finally have portraits in the picker, along with the three new ones

BUG FIX: Three team bonuses stopped working when the DLC landed — Genitour, the free Llama, and the Condottiero. The game moved them onto a different mechanism and emptied the old one, so the cards quietly did nothing. Fixed, and they work whether or not you have updated the game

BUG FIX: Five card descriptions the DLC made wrong are corrected — the Vietnamese HP bonus, the Teuton armor bonus, Longboats (now Longships), Chieftains and Wagenburg Tactics. Atheism's description now covers what it actually does
BUG FIX: Bonus multipliers no longer break script-driven unique techs. Setting one to x2 could send the game looking for a completely different effect — Coiled Serpent Array was reachable this way
BUG FIX: Typing a DAT path by hand now tells you whether it actually worked, instead of leaving you guessing. Thanks to Maruviel on Discord, whose game is on a D: drive

CHANGED: Empire Forge now only offers bonuses, techs and units your installed game actually has. If you have not updated yet, the new content simply is not listed — nothing in the picker is a card that cannot work

CHANGED: "Can garrison Docks with Fishing Ships" has been retired — the game removed the Gurjaras bonus it was built from. The custom unique unit formerly called Varangian Guard is now Hetaireia, since the game now ships a real one

BUG FIX: The Flemish Militia is back. It was only ever reachable as an accidental side effect of the "Farm upgrades +125% food" bonus. Cleaning that up in 2.1.0 removed the unit's only path — it now has its own Unlock the Flemish Militia card (Barracks, Feudal Age)

BUG FIX: Unique unit stats no longer disappear when you open a saved civ. Saved civs deliberately don't store your DAT path (it's specific to your PC), and the stats lookup had no fallback — so every unit's popup read "No stats available" while the civ still built fine
BUG FIX: If your game files genuinely can't be found, the unit popup now says so and points you at Step 1, instead of blaming the units
Unlock cards are now filed under the Unlock category automatically, rather than landing under Research
Thanks to Maruviel on Discord for all three reports.
BUG FIX: Fixed a crash on game startup for civs with many team bonuses — team bonuses are merged into one effect and could exceed the engine's limit. The builder now warns you before you hit it

BUG FIX: Team bonuses were doing each other's jobs. An internal list drifted out of alignment in July, so hand-written team bonuses ran a different bonus entirely — "Spearmen +3 attack vs. cavalry" was secretly "Unique Units +5% HP". All re-aligned
BUG FIX: Reviewed every team bonus for what it actually targets and fixed 12 — some were buffing a war wagon, an ostrich, a sheep and a wild tiger. Two others did nothing at all

BUG FIX: Audited all 350 civ bonus cards against their real in-game effects and fixed everything that didn't match — including several that did nothing, one that secretly unlocked Flemish Militia, and several that stopped working when the unit upgraded
BUG FIX: Bonus multipliers — several were making bonuses weaker at x2 and x3. "Start with…" and "free Villager" cards ignored the multiplier entirely
BUG FIX: Editing a saved civ no longer erases both of its unique techs. If you edited a civ before and its UTs stopped working, this was why — please check them
BUG FIX: The civ-selection screen now shows what your unique techs do, and shows the correct team bonus
NEW: 40 new bonus cards — 35 bonuses that already worked but were unreachable, plus a new "drop off +%" family for food, wood, stone and fishing

CHANGED: 10 team bonuses and the unique unit "Attack Ignores Armor" option have been removed — none of them worked, and the armor option left the unit dealing 1 damage. Saved civs still load; the builder tells you what was skipped
Build messages now name units instead of listing raw ID numbers
NEW: Empire Forge is now a full civilization and mod builder — design tech trees, bonuses, team bonuses, unique units, unique technologies, and hero units natively
NEW: 'Convert KM Civ' tool imports existing KrakenMeister civ JSON files into the new format, so existing civs carry forward
NEW: Live tech tree editor — click any unit, building, or technology to enable or disable it for your civ
NEW: Bonus catalog with search and category filters
Reads your installed game's DAT file directly at build time, so new DLCs won't brick the app
NEW: Microsoft Store / Xbox App installation now auto-detected — DAT file path found automatically on first launch
NEW: Bonus #286 added: Can upgrade Bombard Cannons to Houfnice (properly gated behind Imperial Age even when Bonus #283 is active)

BUG FIX: Bonus #283 (Chemistry/HC in Castle Age) completely reworked — now truly mirrors the Bohemian mechanism (tech 800/801 cloning) so Bombard Cannons, Bombard Towers, and Cannon Galleons all work correctly alongside early Chemistry

BUG FIX: Anarchy / Marauders unique tech — UU now appears at the correct button slot (R key / button 4) in Barracks or Stable after the tech fires; previously overwrote the militia or cavalry line button
BUG FIX: Bonus #222 (Barracks techs one age earlier) no longer clones DLC/Chronicles shadow techs or techs for units not in the civ's tree, preventing unresearchable duplicate buttons
BUG FIX: Vanilla KM unique units now correctly appear as trainable at the Krepost when the civ has Bonus #93 (Can build Krepost)
BUG FIX: Custom unique unit pierce armor stat now displays correctly in the in-game unit stats panel

BUG FIX: Idempotency guards added for Imperial Scorpion (#308), Royal Battle Elephant (#309), and Royal Lancer (#310) — prevents data corruption when multiple civs share these bonuses in a single build
BUG FIX: Custom flag icon now shows correctly in the civilization picker and in-game interface
BUG FIX: Bonus #283 (Chemistry/Hand Cannoneer in Castle Age) no longer breaks Bombard Cannons, Bombard Towers, or Cannon Galleons — now mirrors the Bohemian mechanism
BUG FIX: Bonus #283 (Chemistry/Hand Cannoneer in Castle Age) Chemistry now correctly unlocks in Castle Age — Castle Age trigger was cloned but not wired correctly
BUG FIX: Fixed a bug that prevented camel riders from being trainable
BUG FIX: Fixed Bonus #283 - Chemistry/HC in Castle Age
BUG FIX: Team bonus labels displayed the wrong text in-game and in the builder — team bonuses now read from the correct name list
BUG FIX: Team bonus #30 (Military buildings +5 population room) was silently never applied — now correctly implemented
BUG FIX: Bonus #35 (Infantry +20% HP) was allocating dead Castle and Imperial stubs that did nothing — trimmed to the single correct Feudal tech
BUG FIX: Bonus #55 (Stable units +1 pierce armor in Castle & Imperial Age) only applied in Imperial Age — Castle Age pierce armor now also fires correctly
BUG FIX: Bonus #280 (Folwark replaces the Mill) was allocating 7 extra empty/unrelated techs — trimmed to the correct 4-tech Poles chain
BUG FIX: Bonus #300 (Camel Scouts available in Feudal Age) produced a 0-command tech — now uses a direct enable command that correctly unlocks unit 1755
BUG FIX: Bonus #26 (TC/Dock work rate per age) had a trailing blank tech — now resolves to a single tech covering all four age variants
BUG FIX: Bonus #105 (Economic upgrades −33% food) previously allocated 10 dead stubs — food discount now correctly applies to all 16 standard eco upgrade techs at game start
BUG FIX: Bonus #318 (Start with a Mule Cart) had a blank placeholder tech removed; the actual spawn tech now fires cleanly
BUG FIX: Specific mod fix: Elite Organ Gun/Caravel upgrade buttons missing; UT hover showing wrong civ name; Castle UT showing no effect description; Carrack ×2 giving 0 armor instead of +2
Known limitation noted: Bonus #105 applies the food discount but the 'one age earlier' portion is not yet implemented
Known limitation noted: Bonuses #81 (no buildings to age up), #283 (Chemistry/HC in Castle Age), and #352 (Siege Engineers in Castle Age) require further coding to accommodate.
VOICE LINES: Your selected civs voice lines will now be properly set in-game
Castle/Wonder Skins: Your selected castle and wonder skins will be properly set in-game
After loading the latest version, a popup will show you the most recent changes
'What's New' page added, reading the latest changelog
'How it Works' and 'Why' pages added
Updated Install Instructions
Future-Proofing: The app now reads your games' DAT file *and* civ files, preventing future DLC from breaking it.
All 30 missing team bonuses implemented — full vanilla team bonus coverage achieved (0 unsupported)
New civ bonus #222: Cows trainable from Mills
New civ bonus #356: Pastures replace Farms — clones the Khitan mechanic
Brand New civ bonus #401: Blacksmith attack upgrades also affect building damage (+1 vs buildings per Forging/Iron Casting, +2 per Blast Furnace)
Bonus #327 ('Blacksmith upgrades scale bonus damage') this would require changing multiple attack values manually for every unit in the game. Marked as 'Unlikely to implement' in Known Limitations
Team bonus #60 added (Resources last 5% longer)
Fix: Imperial Skirmisher team bonus (#41) implemented
Fix: Empty Trade Carts 20% faster implemented
Added bonus handlers for unique unit upgrades: Imperial Scorpion (#308), Royal Battle Elephant (#309), Royal Lancer (#310)
Added bonus #9 (Elite Mercenaries) and #29 (First Crusade) castle/imperial UT support with correct UU substitution
Added bonus #400: City Walls (researchable Fortified Wall HP upgrade)
Added bonus #279: Each Monastery tech spawns a free Monk
Added bonuses #277/#278: Gunpowder units and buildings gain attack/HP from University techs
Version tracking and auto-update notifications introduced
